text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":11,"unit":"years","kind":"count","span":"London is 11 years old"},{"id":"q2","value":16,"unit":"years","kind":"count","span":"Blair is 16 years old"},{"id":"q3","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"Blair was twice as old as London"}],"plan":[{"op":"sub","args":["q2","q1"],"out":"s1","note":"age difference between Blair and London, which stays constant over time"},{"op":"mul","args":["q1","q3"],"out":"s2","note":"London's current age times 2, part of setting up the 'twice as old' relationship in the past"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"London's age several years ago, when Blair was twice as old"},"dismissed":[]}
